name: SymbolSyncEA
summary: This EA synchronizes the trading symbol across all open charts in the terminal. When the symbol on the chart where the EA is running changes (via OnInit), it propagates that symbol to up to 10 other open charts using ChartSetSymbolPeriod while preserving each chart's timeframe.
summary_zh: 该EA用于同步终端中所有打开图表的交易品种。当EA所在图表的品种发生变化时（通过OnInit触发），它会将该品种传播到最多10个其他打开的图表中，同时保持各图表的原有时间周期不变。
strategy_analysis: 这不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个图表管理工具。其核心概念是品种同步：当用户在某一图表上切换品种时，EA自动将所有其他图表也切换到同一品种。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不进行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及，因为该EA不打开任何仓位。其同步机制依赖于OnInit事件——每次图表品种变更时MetaTrader5会重新调用OnInit，从而触发SyncSymbols函数遍历最多10个图表并调用ChartSetSymbolPeriod进行品种切换。此外，代码中保留了OnTimer定时器逻辑作为备选方案（已注释掉），用于轮询检测品种变化，但当前未启用。
strategy_analysis_en: This is not a trading strategy EA but a chart management utility. Its core concept is symbol synchronization: when the user changes the symbol on one chart, the EA automatically switches all other open charts to the same symbol. Entry conditions are not applicable since this tool does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable. Position sizing and money management are not involved as the EA never opens positions. The synchronization mechanism relies on the OnInit event—MetaTrader 5 re-invokes OnInit whenever a chart's symbol changes, which triggers the SyncSymbols function to iterate through up to 10 charts and call ChartSetSymbolPeriod to switch symbols. Additionally, the code retains commented-out OnTimer polling logic as an alternative approach for detecting symbol changes, but it is currently disabled.

parameters.name: chartlimit
parameters.description: 同步图表的最大数量限制

parameters.name: initialSymbol
parameters.description: EA初始化时记录的初始品种名称
parameters.description_en: Initial symbol name recorded at EA initialization

parameters.name: SyncSymbol
parameters.description: 当前需要同步到所有图表的目标品种
parameters.description_en: Target symbol to synchronize across all charts

pros: 简洁实用的品种同步功能，多图表分析时提高效率
利用OnInit事件自动触发同步，无需手动操作
保留每个图表原有的时间周期不变，仅切换品种
代码结构清晰简单，易于理解和修改
pros_en: Simple and practical symbol sync function that boosts efficiency during multi-chart analysis
Leverages the OnInit event for automatic triggering, requiring no manual intervention
Preserves each chart's original timeframe while only switching the symbol
Clean and straightforward code structure, easy to understand and modify
cons: 图表同步数量硬编码为10，无法通过参数配置
ChangeChartSymbol函数中PrintFormat的参数顺序错误，symbol和chartID位置互换
缺少对ChartSetSymbolPeriod调用是否成功的返回值检查
OnTimer中的品种变化检测逻辑被注释掉但未删除，代码不够整洁
没有错误处理机制，如ChartNext返回无效ID时缺少保护
cons_en: Chart sync limit is hardcoded to 10 with no configurable parameter
PrintFormat argument order is wrong in ChangeChartSymbol—symbol and chartID are swapped
No return value check on ChartSetSymbolPeriod to verify the symbol change succeeded
OnTimer symbol change detection logic is commented out but not removed, leaving dead code
No error handling for edge cases such as ChartNext returning an invalid ID
improvements: 将chartlimit提取为可配置的输入参数，允许用户自定义同步图表数量
修复ChangeChartSymbol中PrintFormat的参数顺序错误，并添加ChartSetSymbolPeriod的返回值检查
移除已注释的OnTimer代码或将其实现为可选的轮询备选方案，增加对图表ID有效性验证
improvements_en: Extract chartlimit as an input parameter to allow user-configurable chart sync count
Fix the PrintFormat argument order bug in ChangeChartSymbol and add return value validation for ChartSetSymbolPeriod
Remove the commented-out OnTimer code or implement it as an optional polling fallback, and add chart ID validity checks

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
品种切换可能影响其他图表上正在运行的EA或指标，需注意潜在冲突
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, so there is no financial risk
Symbol switching may affect other EAs or indicators running on other charts—potential conflicts should be noted
